title: 너 또
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop acoustic ballad. A bright, fingerstyle acoustic guitar plays a syncopated eighth-note pattern with prominent string squeaks. A clean electric bass guitar enters with melodic slides and syncopated fills. The drums feature a soft kick on beats 1 and 3 with a crisp snare on 2 and 4, accompanied by eighth-note hi-hats. A female vocalist sings in a breathy, intimate chest voice, transitioning to a light head voice for higher melodic leaps. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the rhythmic acoustic guitar and the melodic bass line. 100 BPM, Key of E Major, 4/4 time.
suno_analysis_lyrics:

[fingerstyle acoustic guitar with string squeaks]

잔이 식어가 너 돌아오라고 했지
틀린 말은 아닌 걸 맞는데 왜 이렇게
